subject: Re: PulseGrid demo — reschedule and SSO/procurement coordination
messages:
From: Alex Torres <atorres@pulsegrid.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: linda.park@pulsegrid.io, procurement@pulsegrid.io
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: PulseGrid — planned demo this week (outage impact)

Hi Rachel,

Quick update from our side: we just had an infrastructure incident at one of our US regions this morning and our platform team has paused all integrations for the next 48 hours while they investigate. That means the walkthrough we had planned for this Thursday is likely not possible.

Would you be able to move the demo to next week (any time Apr 20–23)? We still want the full stack walkthrough (SE-run), but we need to include our security and procurement folks to confirm timeline for SSO test and contract signature.

Attaching the outage report we just sent to stakeholders so you have context.

Thanks — sorry for the late notice.

—Alex
Alex Torres
Director of Engineering, PulseGrid
atorres@pulsegrid.io
(415) 555-0187

[Attachment: pulsegrid-outage-report.pdf (pdf)]

From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Torres <atorres@pulsegrid.io>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, linda.park@pulsegrid.io, procurement@pulsegrid.io
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PulseGrid — planned demo this week (outage impact)

Alex — thanks for flagging and sending the report. Hope the team gets it sorted quickly.

We can absolutely shift the walkthrough. A couple of constraints from our side I want to call out so we can pick a time that works for everyone:
- Connor (our primary SE) has travel already booked Apr 20–21 and is out of pocket.
- We can either 1) move the full SE-led demo to Apr 22–23 when Connor is back, or 2) run a condensed session Apr 21 with an alternate SE if you need an earlier slot.

Connor, Mina — can you confirm coverage options? Mina, would you be able to lead an Apr 21 session if PulseGrid needs it?

Linda/procurement — if you have preferred windows for the SSO test and contract review next week, please share; PulseGrid noted they need security signoff and procurement timelines to align with the demo.

I'll hold the original slot tentatively for now and send updated invites once we lock.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
[calendar: tentative hold]

From: connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, Alex Torres <atorres@pulsegrid.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PulseGrid — planned demo this week (outage impact)

Thanks for the heads-up. Travel plans for Apr 20–21 were just extended (unexpected site visit), so I can't make any earlier slots that week.

Options from my side:
- Apr 23 (PST) — I can run the full SE-led walkthrough in the morning (preferred).
- Apr 21 — I can only participate asynchronously; Mina can lead a condensed 45–60 minute demo if PulseGrid needs to keep things moving.

Mina — I put together a short coverage plan (attached) that maps the flows I would normally cover and suggested fallbacks for the condensed run. If you're able to lead Apr 21, follow the SE-coverage-plan and we should be OK.

Also, we'll need:
- A test AAD account for SSO (one-time test user) or an SSO sandbox window (preferred).
- Any IP allowlist or network egress notes if PulseGrid has strict egress controls.

Attached: SE-coverage-plan.pdf

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: SE-coverage-plan.pdf (pdf)]

From: Linda Park <linda.park@pulsegrid.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Torres <atorres@pulsegrid.io>, procurement@pulsegrid.io
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PulseGrid — planned demo this week (outage impact)

Hi all,

Security here — we can’t commit to an SSO test until the platform team finishes their post-incident checks. We expect at least 48 hours, which pushes earliest safe testing window to Apr 15 (UTC) — given calendars, that effectively rules out Apr 19–21 for anything that needs a live SSO test.

If you want to run a purely UI-driven demo (no SSO) earlier, we can do that, but the SSO verification (which PulseGrid requested) will need Apr 23 or later.

If Apr 23 works: we prefer 10:00–11:00 PDT to slot in our security engineer. Please also share:
- A short SOC2 excerpt or link to your compliance packet (we require doc-level evidence before running live auth tests),
- A test AAD account or instructions for creating a temporary test user, and
- Any network allowlist steps.

Sending over our security checklist in this thread.

—Linda
Linda Park
Security Lead, PulseGrid
linda.park@pulsegrid.io
[Attachment: security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Torres <atorres@pulsegrid.io>, Linda Park <linda.park@pulsegrid.io>, procurement@pulsegrid.io
Cc: connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: PulseGrid demo — Apr 23 10:00–11:00 PDT (SE coverage)

Thanks everyone — based on availability and the security window, let’s lock Apr 23 10:00–11:00 PDT for the full walkthrough with SSO verification.

Plan / next steps:
- SE coverage: Mina will be the primary SE for the session. Connor will join to cover advanced integration questions if he’s back online.
- Security: Linda, we’ll share the SOC2 excerpt and create a temporary AAD test user by EOD Apr 21.
- Procurement: Rachel will send the updated quote and DocuSign link; please flag if you need a PO beforehand.
- Calendar: I’ve attached a calendar invite stub (invite-Redwood-PulseGrid.ics) and will send a live invite once procurement confirms the attendee list.

Links: HubSpot deal PG-2027-0893 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/PG-2027-0893) and DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/00A1B2C3D4E5F6G7).

If anything changes, flag it here and we’ll adjust — otherwise I’ll send invites and the SOC2 excerpt by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: invite-Redwood-PulseGrid.ics (calendar invite stub)]
